ns0:Property.ns0:Value: BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXECUTE dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Enrollment.Manage'; IF @SourceAcademicYearId <= 0 THROW 52501, 'A valid source academic year is required.', 1; IF @DestinationAcademicYearId <= 0 THROW 52502, 'A valid destination academic year is required.', 1; IF @DestinationAcademicYearId = @SourceAcademicYearId THROW 52503, 'Bulk Promotion must move students into a different academic year. Use Transfer Class for same-year movement.', 1; IF @SourceCampusId <= 0 OR @SourceClassId <= 0 THROW 52504, 'A valid source campus and class are required.', 1; IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @Decisions WHERE Decision = N'PROMOTE') AND @DestinationClassSectionId <= 0 THROW 52506, 'A valid destination class/section is required for promoted students.', 1; IF @EffectiveDate IS NULL THROW 52508, 'The effective date is required.', 1; IF @EffectiveDate > CONVERT (DATE, SYSDATETIME()) THROW 52509, 'The effective date cannot be in the future.', 1; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @Decisions) THROW 52510, 'Select at least one student to process.', 1; IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @Decisions WHERE Decision NOT IN (N'PROMOTE', N'HOLD')) THROW 52511, 'Bulk promotion contains an invalid decision.', 1; DECLARE @SourceStartDate AS DATE, @DestinationStartDate AS DATE, @DestinationEndDate AS DATE, @DestinationCampusId AS INT, @DestinationClassId AS INT; SELECT @SourceStartDate = StartDate FROM dbo.AcademicYears WHERE AcademicYearId = @SourceAcademicYearId; SELECT @DestinationStartDate = StartDate, @DestinationEndDate=EndDate FROM dbo.AcademicYears WHERE AcademicYearId = @DestinationAcademicYearId; IF @SourceStartDate IS NULL THROW 52512, 'The source academic year is invalid.', 1; IF @DestinationStartDate IS NULL THROW 52513, 'The destination academic year is invalid.', 1; IF @DestinationStartDate <= @SourceStartDate THROW 52514, 'The destination academic year must be later than the source academic year.', 1; IF @EffectiveDate<@DestinationStartDate OR (@DestinationEndDate IS NOT NULL AND @EffectiveDate>@DestinationEndDate) THROW 52520,'The effective date must fall within the destination academic year.',1; IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @Decisions WHERE Decision = N'PROMOTE') BEGIN SELECT @DestinationCampusId = CCS.CampusId, @DestinationClassId = CCS.ClassId FROM dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS WHERE CCS.ClassSectionId = @DestinationClassSectionId; IF @DestinationCampusId IS NULL THROW 52516, 'The destination class/section is invalid.', 1; IF @DestinationCampusId <> @SourceCampusId THROW 52517, 'Bulk Promotion cannot move students between campuses.', 1; END ELSE BEGIN SET @DestinationClassSectionId = NULL; END IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @Decisions WHERE Decision = N'PROMOTE') BEGIN DECLARE @MissingMandatoryFeesDest AS NVARCHAR (1000); SELECT @MissingMandatoryFeesDest = STRING_AGG(FT.FeeTypeName, N', ') FROM dbo.FeeTypes AS FT WHERE FT.IsMandatory = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.FeeConfigurations AS FC WHERE FC.CampusId = @DestinationCampusId AND FC.ClassId = @DestinationClassId AND FC.FeeTypeId = FT.FeeTypeId); IF @MissingMandatoryFeesDest IS NOT NULL BEGIN DECLARE @MandatoryFeeErrorMsgDest AS NVARCHAR (1100) = N'Required fee configuration is missing for the destination class: ' + @MissingMandatoryFeesDest + N'.'; THROW 52519, @MandatoryFeeErrorMsgDest, 1; END END BEGIN TRANSACTION; SELECT E.EnrollmentId, E.AdmissionId, E.ClassSectionId, E.UsesTransport, D.Decision, C.ClassId AS CurrentClassId, CCS.CampusId AS CurrentCampusId INTO #Selected FROM @Decisions AS D INNER JOIN dbo.Enrollments AS E WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) ON E.AdmissionId = D.AdmissionId AND E.Status = N'Active' AND E.AcademicYearId = @SourceAcademicYearId INNER JOIN dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS ON CCS.ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId INNER JOIN dbo.Classes AS C ON C.ClassId = CCS.ClassId WHERE CCS.CampusId = @SourceCampusId AND CCS.ClassId = @SourceClassId AND (@SourceSectionId = 0 OR CCS.SectionId = @SourceSectionId); IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @Decisions AS D LEFT OUTER JOIN #Selected AS S ON S.AdmissionId = D.AdmissionId WHERE S.AdmissionId IS NULL) THROW 52521, 'One or more selected students are no longer active in the selected source class. Reload the candidates and try again.', 1; ALTER TABLE #Selected ADD NewClassSectionId INT NULL; UPDATE #Selected SET NewClassSectionId = CASE WHEN Decision = N'PROMOTE' THEN @DestinationClassSectionId ELSE ClassSectionId END; IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Selected AS S INNER JOIN dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS ON CCS.ClassSectionId = S.NewClassSectionId WHERE CCS.CampusId <> @SourceCampusId) THROW 52522, 'One or more destination class/sections are invalid for the source campus.', 1; DECLARE @BatchLockResult AS INT; DECLARE @BatchLockResource AS NVARCHAR (255) = N'FMSC.BulkPromotion.' + CONVERT (NVARCHAR (20), @SourceAcademicYearId) + N'.' + CONVERT (NVARCHAR (20), @SourceClassId) + N'.' + CONVERT (NVARCHAR (20), @SourceCampusId); EXECUTE @BatchLockResult = sys.sp_getapplock @Resource = @BatchLockResource, @LockMode = N'Exclusive', @LockOwner = N'Transaction', @LockTimeout = 0; IF @BatchLockResult < 0 THROW 52523, 'Another bulk promotion is currently processing this class. Please try again after it completes.', 1; DECLARE @OperationId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NEWID(); INSERT dbo.AuditOperations (OperationId, UserId, OperationType, CorrelationNote) VALUES (@OperationId, @UserId, N'BULK_PROMOTION', CONVERT (NVARCHAR (200), @SourceAcademicYearId)); INSERT dbo.PromotionBatches (SourceAcademicYearId, DestinationAcademicYearId, SourceCampusId, SourceClassId, SourceSectionId, DestinationClassSectionId, EffectiveDate, Remarks, CreatedByUserId) VALUES (@SourceAcademicYearId, @DestinationAcademicYearId, @SourceCampusId, @SourceClassId, NULLIF (@SourceSectionId, 0), @DestinationClassSectionId, @EffectiveDate, @Remarks, @UserId); DECLARE @PromotionBatchId AS INT = SCOPE_IDENTITY(); IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CCS.CampusId, CCS.ClassId FROM #Selected AS S INNER JOIN dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS ON CCS.ClassSectionId = S.NewClassSectionId) AS D WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.FeeTypes AS FT WHERE FT.IsMandatory = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.FeeConfigurations AS FC WHERE FC.CampusId = D.CampusId AND FC.ClassId = D.ClassId AND FC.FeeTypeId = FT.FeeTypeId))) THROW 52524, 'Required fee configuration is missing for one or more destination classes.', 1; IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #Selected X JOIN dbo.Students S ON S.AdmissionId=X.AdmissionId WHERE S.LegacySetupPending=1) THROW 59751,'Finish legacy verification and Go Live before promoting these students.',1; IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #Selected S JOIN dbo.Enrollments E ON E.EnrollmentId=S.EnrollmentId WHERE E.PlacementConfirmedAt IS NULL) THROW 59646,'Confirm the source placement in Admission before promotion.',1; IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.BillingCharges B WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) JOIN #Selected S ON S.EnrollmentId=B.EnrollmentId WHERE B.Status<>N'Cancelled' AND COALESCE(B.BillingMonth,B.ChargeDate)>DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(DATEADD(day,-1,@EffectiveDate)),MONTH(DATEADD(day,-1,@EffectiveDate)),1)) THROW 59632,'Charges exist after the promotion effective date. Review unpaid charges in Fee Collection or paid charges in Fee Corrections, then retry. No students were promoted.',1; UPDATE E SET Status = N'Promoted', LeavingDate = @EffectiveDate, UpdatedAt = SYSDATETIME(), Remarks = COALESCE (NULLIF (@Remarks, N''), E.Remarks) FROM dbo.Enrollments AS E INNER JOIN #Selected AS S ON S.EnrollmentId = E.EnrollmentId WHERE E.Status = N'Active'; IF @@ROWCOUNT <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #Selected) THROW 52525, 'The source enrollments could not all be closed as historical enrollments.', 1; DECLARE @CutoffDay AS INT; SELECT TOP (1) @CutoffDay = SP.FeeProrationCutoffDay FROM dbo.SchoolProfile AS SP; INSERT dbo.Enrollments (AdmissionId, AcademicYearId, ClassSectionId, EnrollmentDate, BillingStartDate, Status, UsesTransport, BillingReady, Remarks, PlacementConfirmedAt) SELECT S.AdmissionId, @DestinationAcademicYearId, S.NewClassSectionId, @EffectiveDate, CASE WHEN @CutoffDay BETWEEN 1 AND 28 AND DAY(@EffectiveDate) >= @CutoffDay THEN DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@EffectiveDate), MONTH(@EffectiveDate), 1)) ELSE @EffectiveDate END, N'Active', 0, 0, CASE WHEN S.Decision = N'PROMOTE' THEN N'Created by bulk promotion' ELSE N'Created by bulk promotion - held back/repeat class' END, SYSDATETIME() FROM #Selected AS S; DECLARE @NewEnrollments TABLE ( AdmissionId INT NOT NULL, OldEnrollmentId INT NOT NULL, NewEnrollmentId INT NOT NULL, Decision NVARCHAR (20) NOT NULL, NewClassSectionId INT NOT NULL, UsesTransport BIT NOT NULL); INSERT INTO @NewEnrollments (AdmissionId, OldEnrollmentId, NewEnrollmentId, Decision, NewClassSectionId, UsesTransport) SELECT S.AdmissionId, S.EnrollmentId, E.EnrollmentId, S.Decision, S.NewClassSectionId, 0 FROM #Selected AS S INNER JOIN dbo.Enrollments AS E ON E.AdmissionId = S.AdmissionId AND E.AcademicYearId = @DestinationAcademicYearId AND E.Status = N'Active'; IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @NewEnrollments) <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #Selected) THROW 52526, 'The new academic-year enrollments could not all be created.', 1; INSERT dbo.StudentFeeAssignments (EnrollmentId, AdmissionId, FeeTypeId, Amount, DiscountAmount, Frequency, Remarks) SELECT N.NewEnrollmentId, N.AdmissionId, FC.FeeTypeId, FC.Amount, 0, FC.Frequency, CASE WHEN N.Decision = N'PROMOTE' THEN N'Created by bulk promotion' ELSE N'Created by bulk promotion - held back/repeat class' END FROM @NewEnrollments AS N INNER JOIN dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS ON CCS.ClassSectionId = N.NewClassSectionId INNER JOIN dbo.FeeConfigurations AS FC ON FC.CampusId = CCS.CampusId AND FC.ClassId = CCS.ClassId INNER JOIN dbo.FeeTypes AS FT ON FT.FeeTypeId = FC.FeeTypeId WHERE FT.IsMandatory = 1 AND FT.IsTransportLinked = 0; INSERT dbo.EnrollmentHistory (EnrollmentId, AdmissionId, ActionType, ActionDate, OldClassSectionId, NewClassSectionId, OldStatus, NewStatus, Remarks, UserId) SELECT N.OldEnrollmentId, N.AdmissionId, CASE WHEN N.Decision = N'PROMOTE' THEN N'BULK_PROMOTE' ELSE N'BULK_HOLD' END, @EffectiveDate, S.ClassSectionId, N.NewClassSectionId, N'Active', N'Promoted', CASE WHEN N.Decision = N'PROMOTE' THEN N'Bulk promoted to EnrollmentId ' + CONVERT (NVARCHAR (20), N.NewEnrollmentId) ELSE N'Bulk held back/repeated class in new academic year; EnrollmentId ' + CONVERT (NVARCHAR (20), N.NewEnrollmentId) END, @UserId FROM @NewEnrollments AS N INNER JOIN #Selected AS S ON S.AdmissionId = N.AdmissionId; INSERT dbo.PromotionBatchStudents (PromotionBatchId, AdmissionId, OldEnrollmentId, NewEnrollmentId, Decision, Remarks) SELECT @PromotionBatchId, N.AdmissionId, N.OldEnrollmentId, N.NewEnrollmentId, N.Decision, CASE WHEN N.Decision = N'PROMOTE' THEN N'Promoted to destination class.' ELSE N'Held back/repeated the current class in the destination academic year.' END FROM @NewEnrollments AS N INNER JOIN #Selected AS S ON S.AdmissionId = N.AdmissionId; DECLARE @ProcessedCount AS INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @NewEnrollments), @PromotedCount AS INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @NewEnrollments WHERE Decision = N'PROMOTE'), @HeldBackCount AS INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @NewEnrollments WHERE Decision = N'HOLD'); UPDATE dbo.PromotionBatches SET ProcessedCount = @ProcessedCount, PromotedCount = @PromotedCount, HeldBackCount = @HeldBackCount WHERE PromotionBatchId = @PromotionBatchId; DECLARE @AuditValues AS NVARCHAR (MAX); SELECT @AuditValues = (SELECT @PromotionBatchId AS PromotionBatchId, @SourceAcademicYearId AS SourceAcademicYearId, @DestinationAcademicYearId AS DestinationAcademicYearId, @SourceCampusId AS SourceCampusId, @SourceClassId AS SourceClassId, @SourceSectionId AS SourceSectionId, @DestinationClassSectionId AS DestinationClassSectionId, @EffectiveDate AS EffectiveDate, @ProcessedCount AS ProcessedCount, @PromotedCount AS PromotedCount, @HeldBackCount AS HeldBackCount, @Remarks AS Remarks FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES); DECLARE @PromotionBatchAuditRecordId AS NVARCHAR (200) = CONVERT (NVARCHAR (200), @PromotionBatchId); EXECUTE dbo.WriteAuditLog @OperationId = @OperationId, @UserId = @UserId, @TableName = N'PromotionBatches', @RecordId = @PromotionBatchAuditRecordId, @Action = N'BULK_PROMOTION', @OldValues = NULL, @NewValues = @AuditValues; DELETE dbo.AuditOperations WHERE OperationId=@OperationId AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.AuditLogs WHERE OperationId=@OperationId); COMMIT TRANSACTION; SELECT @PromotionBatchId AS PromotionBatchId, @ProcessedCount AS ProcessedCount, @PromotedCount AS PromotedCount, @HeldBackCount AS HeldBackCount; END
